results.title: Two users sign up through the UI, sign out; a wrong password is refused with a message
User one creates a diagram in the UI; it stays after a reload
API ownership: a user cannot change/delete a foreign diagram, tag or comment (403/404); the owner and author can
results.note: comment by another user -> 400 {'error': 'Invalid comment data', 'details': [{'field': 'text', 'message': 'must be a non-empty string'}]}

results.title: API roles: admin-only /users, no self-promotion, role set at sign-up ignored, role changes and deleted users take effect at once
API errors: 401 without a token, 400 invalid body, 404 unknown id/route, 405 wrong method
UI: guest redirected, user gets 403 on /admin, 404 pages, admin lists users
UI comments: another user posts, edits and deletes own comment; a tag on a foreign diagram is refused
Switching accounts in one profile: the token is replaced and each user sees the right data
results.note: owner does not see own diagram after switching accounts

results.title: A damaged token in localStorage: the user is sent to sign-in, no crash
Storage disabled (private mode): the login page still renders without errors
Token expiry (JWT_EXPIRES_IN=5): after expiry the app shows the sign-in form
